n3958c444f7.headline: Raise £12bn in budget by extending income tax thresholds freeze, says thinktank
n3958c444f7.summary: The Fabian Society says extending the income tax thresholds freeze is the best available option for the chancellor. It would raise £12bn as weaker economic forecasts widen the budget gap.
n3958c444f7.why: Fiscal policy choices such as tax thresholds shape government borrowing needs, which feed into gilt yields and the pound.

n99feb6345f.headline: In the rural South where Medicaid has been a lifeline, residents brace for cuts
n99feb6345f.summary: Medicaid cutbacks are expected to leave millions in the U.S. uninsured. Residents of the Mississippi Delta, one of the poorest U.S. regions, say they are stressed by the prospect.
n99feb6345f.why: Medicaid is the federal-state health insurance program for low-income Americans, so changes to its funding affect hospitals, insurers and health-care providers.

n2ebff33248.headline: Chamber of Licensed Gold Buyers commend GoldBod for transforming ASM sector and boosting gold output
n2ebff33248.summary: The Chamber of Licensed Gold Buyers praised the Ghana Gold Board for formalising the artisanal and small-scale mining sector and increasing gold production and exports, according to a statement in Accra.
n2ebff33248.why: Ghana is a significant African gold producer, and formalisation of small-scale mining affects official output, exports and tax revenue.

n938214a666.headline: In US tariff talks, Brazil’s rare earths a ‘trump card’
n938214a666.summary: Brazil's rare earths are likely to come up during a meeting between US President Donald Trump and his Brazilian counterpart at the Asean summit.
n938214a666.why: Rare earths are critical inputs for electronics, batteries and defence equipment, so trade terms over them matter to global supply chains.

na0ed872852.headline: Asean in final stages of negotiating FTA with EU, says Tok Mat
na0ed872852.summary: Asean is in the final stages of negotiating a free trade agreement with the European Union, Foreign Minister Mohamad Hasan said.
na0ed872852.why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs and barriers between blocs, affecting export opportunities for companies on both sides.

n0b54a189b6.headline: Lucy Powell wins UK Labour deputy leadership race, beating Phillipson
n0b54a189b6.summary: Lucy Powell won the UK Labour deputy leadership election on a call for the party to change course. The result could cause trouble for Prime Minister Keir Starmer.
n0b54a189b6.why: Changes in UK political leadership can shift expectations for fiscal policy, which influences gilt yields and sterling.

n9bf6f1f0d8.headline: Argentina goes to polls amid economic crisis and Trump ‘interference’
n9bf6f1f0d8.summary: Argentines vote on Sunday amid an economic crisis and alleged Trump interference. A poor showing would be a heavy blow to President Javier Milei.
n9bf6f1f0d8.why: Argentina has a history of currency and debt volatility, so the election outcome shapes investor views of its economic reform program.

n250398e96d.headline: Wall Street Is Worried About an AI Bubble—Here
n250398e96d.summary: AI infrastructure spending has lifted sales and stocks across sectors, with power providers and nuclear start-ups seeing the sharpest valuation gains.
n250398e96d.why: Power providers supply electricity to data centers, so their valuations are increasingly tied to AI infrastructure demand.

n255a8ff5fd.headline: Trump says he’s increasing tariffs on Canada by 10% after Ontario’s Reagan ad
n255a8ff5fd.summary: President Donald Trump said he is increasing the tariff on Canada by 10% over current levels, citing a 'fake' Ontario ad that used parts of a 1987 Reagan anti-tariff speech. The move escalates trade tensions.
n255a8ff5fd.why: Tariffs raise costs for importers and exporters and can shift trade flows, affecting companies with cross-border supply chains. Canada is one of the largest trading partners of the United States.
n255a8ff5fd.why_moved: The announced 10% increase in US tariffs on Canadian goods raises trade-cost expectations for Canadian exporters and cross-border supply chains. The escalation adds to trade-policy uncertainty.

n7ab5c6d0fd.headline: Mexico’s footwear industry could benefit from US tariffs. But it’s not
n7ab5c6d0fd.summary: Mexican shoe businesses can export to the US tariff-free under USMCA, but outdated policies and corrupt practices hold the industry back, according to the report.
n7ab5c6d0fd.why: USMCA sets tariff-free trade rules among Mexico, the US and Canada. Footwear is a labor-intensive export industry for Mexico.

n7c7eeb3575.headline: UK government should not cut cash Isa allowance — Treasury Committee
n7c7eeb3575.summary: A UK parliamentary Treasury Committee urged the government not to cut the cash Isa limit. The committee said such a move would be unlikely to persuade more people to invest in stocks and shares.
n7c7eeb3575.why: Individual Savings Accounts are tax-advantaged UK savings vehicles, and changes to their limits affect retail savings flows and investment participation.

n7ed5bd252c.headline: CEO who created Stellantis worried it might break up
n7ed5bd252c.summary: Carlos Tavares, the first CEO of Stellantis, believes the French-Italian-American carmaker may be too unwieldy to manage. The comments raise questions about the group's structure.
n7ed5bd252c.why: Stellantis is a major global carmaker formed from a merger of PSA and Fiat Chrysler, so its management structure affects its strategy and valuation.

n3be71b20a0.headline: UK Chancellor Reeves declines to rule out income tax hike
n3be71b20a0.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves has declined to rule out raising income tax at next month's Budget. She had previously insisted Labour's manifesto pledge not to raise income tax would be kept.
n3be71b20a0.why: Budget tax decisions by the UK Treasury shape public finances, gilt yields and sterling, and they affect household and corporate cash flows.

nebe2a5c744.headline: Will millions of low-income Americans lose food stamps during shutdown?
nebe2a5c744.summary: About 42 million people rely on SNAP benefits and now face reductions or losing access altogether during the government shutdown. The shutdown has disrupted the programme's funding.
nebe2a5c744.why: SNAP is the largest US federal food assistance programme, and changes to it affect consumer spending in the grocery and retail sectors.

n11d3d97543.headline: Seshasayee Paper Q2 net profit falls 21 pc to Rs 22.4 crore
n11d3d97543.summary: Seshasayee Paper and Boards reported a 21.3% year-on-year fall in consolidated net profit for the second quarter of FY26. The figures were disclosed in a regulatory filing.
n11d3d97543.why: Seshasayee Paper is an Indian paper and boards manufacturer, and its quarterly profits reflect pricing and input-cost conditions in the paper industry.

n9d071c38cb.headline: Tokyo to boost chip, AI collaborations with Malaysia and Asean
n9d071c38cb.summary: Japan's ambassador says Malaysia is viewed as a trusted and strategic partner, and Tokyo plans to boost chip and AI collaborations with Malaysia and Asean.
n9d071c38cb.why: Malaysia is a significant semiconductor assembly and testing hub, so Japan-Malaysia cooperation touches the regional chip supply chain.

nfb2c829eee.headline: Trump's Asia tour to feature summit with Chinese President Xi, trade, investment deals across region
nfb2c829eee.summary: US President Donald Trump arrives in Kuala Lumpur on Saturday to start an Asia tour covering Malaysia, South Korea and Japan, with a summit with Chinese President Xi and trade deals planned amid an ongoing trade war.
nfb2c829eee.why: US-China trade relations and tariff policy directly affect global supply chains, commodity flows and corporate earnings.

n5c1638b8a9.headline: Lithuania shuts down two largest airports, border — after smugglers’ balloons violate airspace
n5c1638b8a9.summary: Lithuania shut down its two largest airports and a border crossing after smugglers' helium balloons from Belarus violated airspace. Air traffic was halted until early Saturday morning.
n5c1638b8a9.why: Airport and border closures disrupt air freight, trade flows and travel, and they signal regional security tensions on the EU's eastern frontier.

ndeb25fc0c6.headline: Gold Rates in Pakistan Today - Per Tola Gold Price - 25 October 2025
ndeb25fc0c6.summary: Gold prices in Pakistan tumbled over the weekend as the market mirrored sharp moves in global bullion markets. The input does not give specific price levels.
ndeb25fc0c6.why: Gold is a traditional store of value, and its price is set by global bullion markets, which affects local prices in import-dependent markets.

n4815cb2e48.headline: SriLankan Airlines clarifies on financial performance
n4815cb2e48.summary: SriLankan Airlines reported a group loss of LKR 2,735 million for 2024/25, compared with a profit of LKR 7,925 million in 2023/24. The airline issued a clarification on its results.
n4815cb2e48.why: SriLankan Airlines is the state-owned national carrier of Sri Lanka. Its finances affect public liabilities and the country's air connectivity.

n45b48be774.headline: JazzCash, Easypaisa Users to lose access after October 25?
n45b48be774.summary: JazzCash and Easypaisa users across Pakistan may face service disruptions from October 25 as the central bank enforces new measures.
n45b48be774.why: JazzCash and Easypaisa are major mobile wallet and digital banking platforms in Pakistan, so central bank rules directly affect their operations.

n60a4687910.headline: US dollar makes modest weekly gain after soft inflation data
n60a4687910.summary: US inflation eased more than expected in September, fuelling hopes for Federal Reserve rate cuts. Oil prices rose on new US sanctions, affecting currencies including the yen.
n60a4687910.why: The US dollar is the world's main reserve currency, and Federal Reserve rate expectations drive its value and global borrowing costs. Inflation data is a key input to those expectations.
n60a4687910.why_moved: Softer inflation fuelled hopes for Federal Reserve rate cuts, while new US sanctions pushed oil prices higher and weighed on currencies such as the yen.

n722de86e43.headline: Bitcoin Trail Leads to Terror: Queens Man Convicted for Funding ISIS
n722de86e43.summary: A man in the US has been convicted for supporting ISIS through crypto and money laundering activities.
n722de86e43.why: Cryptocurrency-related terrorism funding cases impact regulatory scrutiny and crypto market perceptions.

n6021bf4f0c.headline: Brazilian President Lula receives official welcome in Malaysia ahead of Asean Summit
n6021bf4f0c.summary: Brazilian President Lula da Silva's visit to Malaysia signals strengthening economic and diplomatic ties ahead of ASEAN summit.
n6021bf4f0c.why: The visit can enhance trade and investment relations between Brazil and Southeast Asia, impacting regional markets.

n3c8e5d7cf8.headline: Moody's Issues Negative Outlook for France Amid Fiscal Concerns
n3c8e5d7cf8.summary: Moody's downgrades France's credit outlook due to fiscal challenges, signaling potential impacts on borrowing costs.
n3c8e5d7cf8.why: Credit outlooks influence government borrowing costs, investor confidence, and bond markets in France.

n56760dd91f.headline: Azerbaijani oil elevates in price
n56760dd91f.summary: Azeri Light crude oil price increased by $1.09 at Italy’s Augusta port, reflecting regional oil market movements.
n56760dd91f.why: Changes in Azerbaijani oil prices affect regional energy exports, revenues, and global oil markets.

n9ae87cbd69.headline: The Dazzle Of Diwali In A Shining And Struggling Mumbai
n9ae87cbd69.summary: Diwali festivities in Mumbai continue despite air pollution issues, with authorities and residents debating the impact.
n9ae87cbd69.why: Festive activities and pollution levels influence local economic activity and public health policies.

ne9695baac9.headline: Norfolk Southern sees intermodal shipments fall after merger announcement
ne9695baac9.summary: Norfolk Southern reports a decline in intermodal shipments following its merger announcement with Union Pacific.
ne9695baac9.why: Railway shipment volumes are indicators of trade activity and supply chain health, affecting transportation stocks.

impacts.name: Union Pacific
impacts.why: Merger talks may lead to operational disruptions and market share shifts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n6332173289.headline: Japan’s new leadership prods investors to take expansionary bets
n6332173289.summary: Japan’s new leadership under Sanae Takaichi has boosted investor confidence, pushing stocks to record levels while bonds and the yen decline.
n6332173289.why: Japan’s government influences its stock market, bond yields, and currency, affecting global investor sentiment and capital flows.
n6332173289.why_moved: New leadership has increased investor confidence, leading to a rally in stocks and a decline in bonds and yen.

n3802a4cdcf.headline: Ivory Coast presidential election: Who’s standing and what’s at stake?
n3802a4cdcf.summary: Tensions rise as Ivory Coast's presidential candidates prepare for the election, with implications for political stability.
n3802a4cdcf.why: The election outcome can influence economic policies and investor confidence in Ivory Coast, a key West African economy.

n368259da4f.headline: AU urges coordinated action to tackle Africa's food security challenges
n368259da4f.summary: The African Union urges collective efforts to tackle food security challenges across the continent.
n368259da4f.why: Food security impacts economic stability and agricultural markets in Africa, influencing regional trade and investment.
